description: This file defines a 'Session' class that manages session data using the browser's sessionStorage API. It provides methods to get, set, check, remove, and clear session data, encapsulating session storage operations.

classes.name: Session
classes.description: A class that provides methods to interact with session storage, allowing storage, retrieval, and management of session data.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves and parses a JSON object from session storage by key.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stringifies a value and stores it in session storage under the specified key.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in session storage.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key-value pair from session storage.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all data from session storage.
